Purpose: PERMANOVA analysis and supporting materials
- permanova analysis for each depth
- betadisper/permutest() dispersion test for each depth
- pairwise comparisons for each stream combination at each depth
- p value matrix visualization
- bray-curtis heatmap visualization

Necessary Environment Objects
- bugs: ISP main markdown

Environment Objects Created
- many (none relevant for future analysis)

### Set Up

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(vegan)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
library(pheatmap)
library(patchwork)
```

### Model Building

```{r}
# Pairwise stream comparisons within one depth.
pairwise_permanova <- function(dat, species_cols, permutations = 9999) {
  groups <- levels(droplevels(dat$stream))

  if (length(groups) < 2) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  pairs <- combn(groups, 2, simplify = FALSE)

  results <- lapply(pairs, function(pair) {
    pair_dat <- dat %>%
      filter(stream %in% pair) %>%
      droplevels()

    pair_taxa <- as.matrix(pair_dat[, species_cols, drop = FALSE])

    test <- adonis2(
      pair_taxa ~ stream,
      data = pair_dat,
      method = "bray",
      permutations = permutations
    )

    data.frame(
      comparison = paste(pair, collapse = " vs "),
      R2 = test$R2[1],
      F = test$F[1],
      p = test$`Pr(>F)`[1]
    )
  })

  results <- bind_rows(results) %>%
    mutate(p_adjusted = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")) %>%
    arrange(p_adjusted)

  results
}

# PERMANOVA, dispersion test, and pairwise PERMANOVA at each depth.
depth_levels <- levels(droplevels(bugs$depth))

set.seed(2026)

results_by_depth <- lapply(depth_levels, function(d) {
  dat <- bugs %>%
    filter(depth == d) %>%
    droplevels()

  taxa <- as.matrix(dat[, species_cols, drop = FALSE])

  permanova <- adonis2(
    taxa ~ stream,
    data = dat,
    method = "bray",
    permutations = 9999
  )

  dispersion <- betadisper(
    vegdist(taxa, method = "bray"),
    group = dat$stream
  )

  list(
    permanova = permanova,
    dispersion = permutest(dispersion, permutations = 9999),
    pairwise = pairwise_permanova(dat, species_cols)
  )
})

names(results_by_depth) <- depth_levels

# View results
results_by_depth[["surber"]]$permanova
results_by_depth[["surber"]]$dispersion
results_by_depth[["surber"]]$pairwise

results_by_depth[["25"]]$permanova
results_by_depth[["25"]]$dispersion
results_by_depth[["25"]]$pairwise

results_by_depth[["50"]]$permanova
results_by_depth[["50"]]$dispersion
results_by_depth[["50"]]$pairwise

```

significant permanova for all three depths, stream communities are significantly different across streams (temperatures). One significant dispersion test for 25, this means that the statistically significant permanova result could be a reflection of centroid dispersion differences rathe than true stream to stream differences

### P value compairsons - Visualization

#### Data frame building
```{r}
pairwise_unique <- pairwise_results %>%
  separate(
    comparison,
    into = c("stream_a", "stream_b"),
    sep = " vs ",
    remove = FALSE
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    i = match(stream_a, stream_order),
    j = match(stream_b, stream_order),
    stream1 = if_else(i < j, stream_a, stream_b),
    stream2 = if_else(i < j, stream_b, stream_a)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(i), !is.na(j), i != j) %>%
  group_by(depth, stream1, stream2) %>%
  summarise(p_adjusted = first(p_adjusted), .groups = "drop")

pairwise_unique %>%
  count(depth, stream1, stream2) %>%
  filter(n > 1)

heatmap_data <- pairwise_unique %>%
  mutate(
    depth = as.character(depth),
    stream1 = factor(stream1, levels = stream_order),
    stream2 = factor(stream2, levels = stream_order),
    significance = if_else(
      p_adjusted < 0.05,
      "Significant",
      "Not significant"
    ),
    label = case_when(
      p_adjusted < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
      TRUE ~ sprintf("%.3f", p_adjusted)
    )
  )
```

#### Visualizations
```{r}
heatmaps_by_depth <- lapply(unique(heatmap_data$depth), function(d) {
  ggplot(
    filter(heatmap_data, depth == d),
    aes(x = stream1, y = stream2, fill = significance)
  ) +
    geom_tile(color = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = label), size = 3) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      name = "BH-adjusted p",
      values = c(
        "Significant" = "#D55E00",
        "Not significant" = "#D9D9D9"
      )
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(limits = stream_order) +
    scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(stream_order)) +
    coord_equal() +
    labs(
      title = paste("Pairwise stream comparisons at depth:", d),
      x = "Stream",
      y = "Stream"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    )
})

names(heatmaps_by_depth) <- unique(heatmap_data$depth)

heatmaps_by_depth[["surber"]]
heatmaps_by_depth[["25"]]
heatmaps_by_depth[["50"]]
```
### Pairwise comparisons with Bray-Curtis

```{r}
# Split the pairwise comparison names
pairwise_p <- pairwise_results %>%
  separate(
    comparison,
    into = c("stream_a", "stream_b"),
    sep = " vs ",
    remove = FALSE
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    i = match(stream_a, stream_order),
    j = match(stream_b, stream_order),
    stream1 = if_else(i < j, stream_a, stream_b),
    stream2 = if_else(i < j, stream_b, stream_a)
  ) %>%
  select(depth, stream1, stream2, p_adjusted)

# mean between stream Bray-Curtis dissimilarity for every pair
bray_pairs <- lapply(unique(as.character(bugs$depth)), function(d) {
  dat <- bugs %>%
    filter(as.character(depth) == d) %>%
    droplevels()

  taxa <- as.matrix(dat[, species_cols, drop = FALSE])
  distances <- as.matrix(vegdist(taxa, method = "bray"))

  stream_pairs <- combn(stream_order, 2, simplify = FALSE)

  bind_rows(lapply(stream_pairs, function(pair) {
    idx1 <- which(dat$stream == pair[1])
    idx2 <- which(dat$stream == pair[2])

    # Skip a pair if either stream has no samples at this depth
    #if (length(idx1) == 0 || length(idx2) == 0) {
    #  return(NULL)
    #}

    data.frame(
      depth = d,
      stream1 = pair[1],
      stream2 = pair[2],
      mean_bray = mean(distances[idx1, idx2, drop = FALSE])
    )
  }))
}) %>%
  bind_rows()

# Join adjusted p-values and format labels
heatmap_data <- bray_pairs %>%
  left_join(pairwise_p, by = c("depth", "stream1", "stream2")) %>%
  mutate(
    significance = if_else(
      !is.na(p_adjusted) & p_adjusted < 0.05,
      "*",
      ""
    ),
    label = paste0(sprintf("%.2f", mean_bray), significance),
    stream1 = factor(stream1, levels = stream_order),
    stream2 = factor(stream2, levels = stream_order)
  )

# Plot per depth
depth_labels <- c(
  "surber" = "Surface (0 cm)",
  "25" = "25 cm",
  "50" = "50 cm"
)

heatmaps_by_depth <- lapply(unique(heatmap_data$depth), function(d) {
  ggplot(
    filter(heatmap_data, depth == d),
    aes(x = stream1, y = stream2, fill = mean_bray)
  ) +
    geom_tile(color = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = label), size = 3) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(
      name = "Mean Bray-Curtis Dissimilarity",
      limits = c(0.4, 0.9)
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(limits = stream_order[-length(stream_order)]) +
    scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(stream_order[-1])) +
    coord_equal() +
    labs(
      title = depth_labels[[as.character(d)]],
      x = "Stream",
      y = "Stream") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    )
})

names(heatmaps_by_depth) <- unique(heatmap_data$depth)

heatmaps_by_depth[["surber"]]
heatmaps_by_depth[["25"]]
heatmaps_by_depth[["50"]]

combined_heatmap <-
  patchwork::wrap_plots(
    c(
      heatmaps_by_depth[c("surber", "25", "50")],
      list(patchwork::guide_area())
    ),
    ncol = 2,
    guides = "collect"
  ) +
  patchwork::plot_annotation(
    title = "Stream Comparisons of Bray-Curtis Dissimilarity",
    subtitle = "* BH-adjusted pairwise PERMANOVA p < 0.05"
  ) &
  theme(legend.position = "right")

combined_heatmap
```



### Appendix

#### NMDS plot - outdated likely wont run

```{r}
depth_levels <- levels(droplevels(bugs$depth))
stream_levels <- levels(droplevels(bugs$stream))

stream_colors <- setNames(
  grDevices::hcl.colors(length(stream_levels), palette = "Dark 3"),
  stream_levels
)

nmds_scores_by_depth <- lapply(depth_levels, function(d) {
  keep <- !is.na(bugs$depth) & bugs$depth == d

  dat <- droplevels(bugs[keep, , drop = FALSE])
  sub_comm <- comm[keep, , drop = FALSE]

  usable <- complete.cases(sub_comm) & rowSums(sub_comm) > 0
  dat <- droplevels(dat[usable, , drop = FALSE])
  sub_comm <- sub_comm[usable, , drop = FALSE]

  if (nrow(sub_comm) < 3) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  set.seed(2026)
  nmds <- vegan::metaMDS(
    sub_comm,
    distance = "bray",
    k = 2,
    trymax = 100,
    autotransform = FALSE,
    trace = FALSE
  )

  scores_df <- as.data.frame(vegan::scores(nmds, display = "sites"))
  scores_df$stream <- dat$stream
  scores_df$depth <- d
  scores_df
}) %>%
  bind_rows()

nmds_scores_by_depth <- nmds_scores_by_depth %>%
  group_by(depth, stream) %>%
  mutate(n_in_group = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    stream = factor(stream, levels = stream_levels),
    depth = factor(depth, levels = depth_levels)
  )

ggplot(
  nmds_scores_by_depth,
  aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, color = stream)
) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.85) +
  #stat_ellipse(
  #  data = subset(nmds_scores_by_depth, n_in_group >= 3),
  #  aes(group = stream, color = stream),
  #  level = 0.95,
  #  type = "t",
  #  linewidth = 0.7
  #) +
  facet_wrap(~ depth, ncol = length(depth_levels), scales = "fixed") +
  scale_color_manual(values = stream_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "NMDS of community composition by depth",
    subtitle = "Bray-Curtis dissimilarity",
    x = "NMDS1",
    y = "NMDS2",
    color = "Stream"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```

#### Dispersion Summary

```{r}
disp_summary <- lapply(depth_levels, function(d) {
  keep <- bugs$depth == d
  dat <- bugs[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  sub_comm <- comm[keep, , drop = FALSE]

  sub_comm_hel <- decostand(sub_comm, method = "hellinger") #hellimger transformation

  bd <- betadisper(
    dist(sub_comm_hel, method = "euclidean"), #eluciean distance method
    group = dat$stream
  )

  data.frame(
    depth = d,
    stream = names(tapply(bd$distances, dat$stream, mean)),
    mean_distance = as.numeric(tapply(bd$distances, dat$stream, mean))
  )
}) %>%
  bind_rows()

ggplot(disp_summary, aes(x = stream, y = mean_distance, fill = depth)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ depth, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(
    x = "Stream",
    y = "Mean distance to centroid",
    fill = "Depth"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
